title: Whom Did the Gate Keep Out?

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: The royal crest. Yet it shut the gate on us, too.

lines.speaker: observer
lines.text: Deny outside creatures access to the power source. Humans were no exception.

lines.speaker: leader
lines.text: Its orders put the cores before the people outside?

lines.speaker: observer
lines.text: Let's find the intake ledger. We need to know who gave that order.

journalOverride.title: Whom Did the Gate Keep Out?
journalOverride.excerpt:
Abandoned refugee belongings lie outside; sealed royal chests remain within.
The golem denied even humans access to the power source.
journalOverride.body:
When the golem stopped, a tablet bearing the royal crest was revealed: Deny outside creatures access to the power source. That was why the gate had remained closed even to returning humans.

A threadbare blanket, a waterskin and a broken cup showed where people had waited outside. The royal seals on the chests within were still intact. Which had its orders placed first: people or the power source?

The second core bore a different mark from the forest's. The expedition recorded the guard order and followed the chest's intake markings toward the mine and its ledger.
